# HealthCuree AI

> AI-powered hospital management system for appointments, medical records, prescriptions, billing, and instant AI symptom triage. Serving Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview, featured doctors, departments, contact
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, values
- [Departments](/departments): Clinical specialties
- [Doctors](/doctors): Specialist directory with search
- [Services](/services): Full list of hospital services
- [Emergency Care](/emergency): 24/7 emergency and ambulance
- [Pharmacy](/pharmacy): In-house pharmacy details
- [Laboratory](/laboratory): Diagnostics and pathology
- [Health Packages](/health-packages): Preventive check-ups
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Patient stories
- [Blog](/blog): Doctor-authored health articles
- [Gallery](/gallery): Facilities and events
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions
- [Careers](/careers): Job openings
- [Contact](/contact): Contact form, phone, email, map
- [AI Health Assistant](/ai-assistant): AI-guided symptom analysis
